pages.text: And by then, everyone was already asleep. The lamp went soft and yellow, the blanket went warm, and outside the window the whole garden was quiet. Goodnight, everyone. Goodnight.

pages.text: So they all went home the slow way, and there was warm milk, and somebody found the last biscuit and shared it. Everything that was lost was back where it belonged, and everybody yawned at once.

pages.text: They sat on the step and counted the stars until the numbers got muddled and nobody minded. The night was kind. Tomorrow there would be more of it, and that was a good thing to fall asleep on.
